header.formula: w_i = sig(k_fov*(hfov/2-|beta_i|)) * sig(k_a*(A_i/a_min-1)) * sig(k_r*(r_i-r_min)) * occ_i; A_i = (focal_px*marker_size/r_i)^2 * max(cos_theta_i,0); n_eff = sum w_i; s = 1-exp(-n_eff/m_sat); sig(z) = 1/(1+exp(-z)); camera c = (x,y) + R(yaw)*(offset_x,offset_y), camera yaw = yaw + offset_yaw; beta wrapped to [-pi,pi)

occlusion.rule: occ_i = 0 if the 2D segment c -> (p_i + occ_stop*n_i) touches any closed rectangle [xmin,xmax,ymin,ymax], else 1 (Python oracle rule; the C++ layer ray-casts the static map instead) [assumption: rows]

header.what: S2* scorer (spec T-009 §2) at fixed base_link poses
header.notes: r is guarded as max(r, 1e-9) in the divisions; atan2(0,0) = 0. yaw inputs are not pre-wrapped. occ comes from the oracle rectangle rule: compare w/occ directly or feed occ to the C++ scorer when it uses the static-map ray cast.
